<issue>
Title text gets swapped case when set

#### Description

When setting the title property on core properties, the text gets its case swapped unexpectedly. Uppercase letters become lowercase and vice versa.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.parts.coreprops import CorePropertiesPart

# Create a presentation and set title
prs = Presentation()
prs.core_properties.title = "My Presentation Title"

# Check what the title actually became
print(f"Expected: My Presentation Title")
print(f"Actual: {prs.core_properties.title}")

# Or using CorePropertiesPart directly
core_props = CorePropertiesPart.default(None)
core_props.title = "Test Title"
print(f"Expected: Test Title") 
print(f"Actual: {core_props.title}")
```

Expected output:
```
Expected: My Presentation Title
Actual: My Presentation Title
Expected: Test Title
Actual: Test Title
```

Actual output:
```
Expected: My Presentation Title
Actual: mY pRESENTATION tITLE
Expected: Test Title
Actual: tEST tITLE
```

The title text is having its case swapped - uppercase becomes lowercase and lowercase becomes uppercase.
</issue>
